visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In an AI-animated setting, an anthropomorphic bulldog wearing a tan sun hat, a white tank top, and green athletic shorts stands on a wooden step ladder on a high-rise balcony. It pokes a screwdriver into an external AC condenser unit. (2) The AC unit suddenly explodes with a large burst of black smoke and orange sparks; the dog jumps back in surprise as blue slippers and a blue bucket sit on the balcony floor. (3) The scene shifts to an underground parking garage where the bulldog uses a large wrench to bang on a wall-mounted AC unit, causing parts to dent and fall; several beer cans are scattered on the floor. (4) The dog is then seen indoors, standing on a ladder and using a high-pressure water hose to spray an indoor AC unit mounted on the wall; water splashes violently everywhere, soaking the room. (5) Another scene shows the dog on a balcony attempting to unscrew the front of an AC unit, which subsequently falls off entirely and crashes. (6) A series of rapid jump-cuts repeats these various failed repair attempts, showing more smoke, splashing water, and mechanical disasters.
